events.verdict: Oubre Jr. (PHI) momentarily places and removes his hand from Cunningham's (DET) front during his drive and the contact on the play is marginal.
Oubre Jr. (PHI) extends his forearm into Cunningham's (DET) upper body and initiates contact as he defends the driving shot attempt.
Thompson (DET) cleanly dislodges the ball from Grimes (PHI).
Duren (DET) firms up over his right leg in Grimes' (PHI) path as he sets the pick.
Maxey (PHI) cleanly deflects the ball away from Duren (DET).
Cunningham (DET) jumps from point A to point B into Maxey (PHI) and initiates body to body contact as he defends the shot at the rim.
Grimes (PHI) does not have his left arm in a legal vertical position when contact occurs with Holland II's (DET) arm, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Oubre Jr. (PHI) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Pistons.
Green (DET) inbounds the ball within five seconds.
Grimes (PHI) legally contests Thompson's (DET) jump shot attempt.
Duren (DET) moves laterally into Maxey's (PHI) path and initiates body contact that affects his driving shot attempt.

Cunningham (DET) gathers the ball while planting on his right foot and then loses control of the ball as he comes to a stop. Cunningham then legally regathers the ball while planting his left foot and takes one legal step before going into the air for his jump shot attempt.
Drummond (PHI) brushes Cunningham's (DET) arm as he regains possession of the ball.
Thompson (DET) avoids making any contact with Maxey (PHI) during his drive towards the basket.

Maxey (PHI) loses control of the ball as he attempts to bring two hands to the ball, and then legally re-gathers the  ball while planting on his right foot. He then takes two legal steps before releasing his shot attempt.
